column1: # Where a threshold DECISION is actually taken, per rule. Ш7's seam — "a
# threshold is a decision, not a number" — has to cover every row whose options
# carry a threshold, or exclude it by name.
# This is not the same population as enumeration-threshold-decision-shapes.tsv.
# That table classifies the 27 options classes by the shape of the decision they
# offer. This one classifies the 45 rules by who takes it, which is what the
#   For every src/**/*Rule.php that is neither Abstract* nor an interface, read
#   the rule class and — when it extends a base other than AbstractRule — that
#   base as well. Classify by the first match of:
#   Options class: the first `XOptions::class` literal in that same scope;
# WHAT THIS METHOD DOES NOT SEE, stated because two earlier passes were wrong in
# opposite directions and both looked finished:
# - AbstractRule is deliberately outside the walk. It contains a `->getSeverity()`
#   call inside getEffectiveSeverity(), so counting it marks all 45 rules as
#   asking. A pass that included it reported 45/45 "asks"; a pass that ignored
#   inheritance entirely reported the three type-coverage rules as deciding
#   inline, though their AbstractTypeCoverageRule base asks for them.
# - Traits, and a decision delegated to a collaborator object rather than a base
#   class. None is known, none was searched for.
# - A rule that names its options only through a constructor type hint or a
#   string. The probe is the `::class` literal.
# - Whether a rule's inline comparison AGREES with its options class. It does not
#   for InheritanceRule, whose own docblock says it mirrors
#   21 carry no threshold at all (18 decide in the rule, 3 call the helper) —
#   24 carry a threshold: 19 threshold-aware options plus 5 hierarchical roots.
#      2 take the sanctioned one-call path, 18 hand-roll the two-step, and 4
#      decide in the rule body: DataClassRule and GodClassRule (already named
#      inauditable), plus ClassRankRule, which rescales the pair by project size
#      before comparing, and InheritanceRule, which duplicates the comparison.
